lines.zh: 我拖着八十厘米的身子游过虚空。
lines.en: I haul my eighty-centimeter body across the void.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛比身体还忙，四处扫。
lines.en: My eyes work harder than my body, sweeping around.

lines.zh: 我游得很稳，水被我压出一道沟。
lines.en: I swim steadily, pressing a groove into the water.

lines.zh: 同类在前面，我不紧不慢地跟。
lines.en: My kin are ahead; I follow without hurry.

lines.zh: 我一摆尾，暗水就被推得很远。
lines.en: One tailbeat pushes the dark water far away.

lines.zh: 我游过的地方，鱼都散了。
lines.en: Where I pass, the smaller fish scatter.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛在动，身体几乎不动。
lines.en: My eyes move while my body barely does.

lines.zh: 我从虚空的水壁边掠过。
lines.en: I skim past the water wall of the void.

lines.zh: 我游得快，可总在最后一刻停。
lines.en: I swim fast but always stop at the last moment.

lines.zh: 我绕着同类转，像在点数。
lines.en: I circle my kin as if taking a count.

lines.zh: 前面有影子，我先看清再走。
lines.en: A shadow ahead; I look closely before moving.

lines.zh: 我身子大，转身要用很大一圈。
lines.en: I am large, so turning takes a wide arc.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底游，眼睛盯着前面。
lines.en: I hug the bottom, eyes fixed ahead.

lines.zh: 我不追，我只是准确地靠近。
lines.en: I do not chase; I simply close in exactly.

lines.zh: 我追着同类的尾巴，保持距离。
lines.en: I trail my kin's tail and keep the gap.

lines.zh: 虚空的暗水，一直往前走。
lines.en: Dark water of the void, going on.

lines.zh: 我抬眼看水面的光，不敢久。
lines.en: I glance at the light above. Not for long.

lines.zh: 尾巴一摆，我又滑回队里。
lines.en: One flick and I slide back into the group.

lines.zh: 我悬在虚空里，两只好大的眼睛。
lines.en: I hang in the void, two enormous eyes.

lines.zh: 我不眨眼，水也替我静着。
lines.en: I never blink, and the water stays still for me.

lines.zh: 捕食者靠近前，我已经看过了。
lines.en: Before a predator nears, I have already seen it.

lines.zh: 我这样大，却很少主动露面。
lines.en: Large as I am, I seldom show myself first.

lines.zh: 暗水里，我的眼睛先亮起来。
lines.en: In the dark water my eyes light up first.

lines.zh: 我停在原处，把周围看了一遍。
lines.en: I hold position and look the whole area over.

lines.zh: 我的身体不动，眼睛在算距离。
lines.en: My body still, my eyes measure the distance.

lines.zh: 虚空很空，空得像我的一只眼。
lines.en: The void is empty, as empty as one of my eyes.

lines.zh: 我很少被钓到，所以总在等。
lines.en: I am rarely hooked, so I am always waiting.

lines.zh: 我没有出生地，只有钓线。
lines.en: I have no birthplace, only a fishing line.

lines.zh: 我慢慢转头，水跟着转了个圈。
lines.en: I turn my head slowly and the water turns with it.

lines.zh: 我的眼睛，比身子更早知道你要来。
lines.en: My eyes know you are coming before my body does.

lines.zh: 安静里，我听见自己的尾巴。
lines.en: In the quiet I hear my own tail.

lines.zh: 我什么都不做，只是看着。
lines.en: I do nothing at all; I only watch.

lines.zh: 你站在水边，我已经看了很久。
lines.en: You stand at the water's edge, and I have watched long.

lines.zh: 你的手在动，我记下了方向。
lines.en: Your hand moves; I note the direction.

lines.zh: 我看你时，你也正好抬头。
lines.en: When I look at you, you happen to look up.

lines.zh: 你身上有捕食者的味道，很淡。
lines.en: You carry a predator's smell, faint but there.

lines.zh: 我盯着你的眼睛，等你先动。
lines.en: I hold your eyes and wait for you to move first.

lines.zh: 你举着钓竿，我知道那是钩。
lines.en: You raise a rod; I know what a hook is.

lines.zh: 你的影子落进水里，我没躲。
lines.en: Your shadow falls on the water and I do not flee.

lines.zh: 我看清了你的每一个动作。
lines.en: I have seen every single one of your movements.

lines.zh: 你的呼吸隔着水，我也听得见。
lines.en: Even through the water, I hear you breathe.

lines.zh: 我这样看着你，你会先移开眼。
lines.en: If I keep watching, you will look away first.

lines.zh: 你的刀砍过来，我的大眼睛眯了。
lines.en: Your blade comes down and my big eyes narrow.

lines.zh: 我有五点血，这一下不轻。
lines.en: I have five health; that blow was not light.

lines.zh: 伤口在侧面，我还在看你。
lines.en: The wound is on my flank, and I am still watching you.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推得转了个方向。
lines.en: That turns me around to face a new direction.

lines.zh: 我这么大的身子，也会疼。
lines.en: Even a body this big can hurt.

lines.zh: 我慢慢退开，眼睛没有移开。
lines.en: I ease back without taking my eyes off you.

lines.zh: 疼的时候，我看得更清楚了。
lines.en: In pain I see everything more clearly.

lines.zh: 你别急着补刀，我还没走。
lines.en: Do not rush the second blow; I am not gone.

lines.zh: 我的鳍破了一角，游起来偏。
lines.en: A corner of my fin is torn and I swim crooked.

lines.zh: 血在水里散开，像一片红雾。
lines.en: My blood spreads through the water like red fog.

lines.zh: 饵落下来，我先看了三秒才动。
lines.en: The bait drops and I wait three seconds before moving.

lines.zh: 那点腥味很远，我已经闻到了。
lines.en: That smell of fish is far off, and I already have it.

lines.zh: 我绕了两圈，判断这不是陷阱。
lines.en: I circle twice and decide it is no trap.

lines.zh: 你晃了晃饵，我的鳍动了一下。
lines.en: You jiggle the bait and one of my fins stirs.

lines.zh: 我不轻易上钩，可这次饿了。
lines.en: I do not take hooks easily, but this time I am hungry.

lines.zh: 那东西太小，配不上我的眼睛。
lines.en: That morsel is too small for eyes like mine.

lines.zh: 我靠近，是为了看清它是什么。
lines.en: I approach in order to see exactly what it is.

lines.zh: 你把饵提起来，我跟了一寸。
lines.en: You lift the bait and I follow it an inch.

lines.zh: 我明知有钩，还是想尝一口。
lines.en: I know there is a hook, and still I want a taste.

lines.zh: 这点诱惑，足够让我动身。
lines.en: This much temptation is enough to move me.

lines.zh: 你撞上来，我的大身子纹丝不动。
lines.en: You hit me and my big body does not shift.

lines.zh: 我有五点血，不怕你这一下。
lines.en: I have five health; I do not fear that blow.

lines.zh: 我这么大，碰你像船碰岸。
lines.en: At my size, meeting you is a boat meeting shore.

lines.zh: 水流被我挤开，你退了半步。
lines.en: The water parts around me and you step back.

lines.zh: 别站在我前面，我转不过来。
lines.en: Do not stand in front; I cannot turn in time.

lines.zh: 你撞在我侧面，我眼睛都没转。
lines.en: You hit my flank and my eyes do not even turn.

lines.zh: 这一下把我推离了原来的位置。
lines.en: That shoves me off the spot I held.

lines.zh: 我在你身边摆尾，水把你冲开。
lines.en: I beat my tail beside you and the water pushes you off.

lines.zh: 我慢慢侧身，让出一点空间。
lines.en: I slowly turn my flank and give you room.

lines.zh: 撞完，我依旧盯着你看。
lines.en: After the impact, I am still watching you.

lines.zh: 两条大鱼并排悬着，眼睛对眼睛。
lines.en: Two big fish hang side by side, eye to eye.

lines.zh: 它的眼睛比我的还大，我看了很久。
lines.en: Its eyes are bigger than mine; I look a long while.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有巢，我们只是靠近。
lines.en: No nest in the void; we simply come near.

lines.zh: 我们的鳍碰了一下，像敲了一下鼓。
lines.en: Our fins touch once, like a drumbeat.

lines.zh: 我绕着它转了一整圈，才停下。
lines.en: I circle it fully once before I stop.

lines.zh: 两条影子叠在一起，水里更暗了。
lines.en: Two shadows overlap and the water grows darker.

lines.zh: 它先游开，我跟着，不紧不慢。
lines.en: It swims off first; I follow at my own pace.

lines.zh: 我把身子侧过来，给它让出水面。
lines.en: I turn sideways and yield the water to it.

lines.zh: 我们一起看着同一片黑。
lines.en: We look into the same patch of black.

lines.zh: 它看了我一眼，我就懂了。
lines.en: It gives me one look, and I understand.

lines.zh: 你把我舀进桶，桶差点装不下。
lines.en: You scoop me in and the bucket barely holds me.

lines.zh: 八十厘米的鱼，桶里只能蜷着。
lines.en: An eighty-centimeter fish can only curl up in a bucket.

lines.zh: 我大得让桶沿都翘起来。
lines.en: I am big enough to tip the bucket's rim up.

lines.zh: 桶里的水一下少了一半。
lines.en: Half the water in the bucket vanishes at once.

lines.zh: 我贴着桶壁，眼睛还在看你。
lines.en: Pressed to the bucket wall, my eyes are still on you.

lines.zh: 你提着我，走得很慢。
lines.en: You carry me and walk very slowly.

lines.zh: 桶盖合上，我的眼睛贴着缝。
lines.en: The lid closes and my eye presses to the seam.

lines.zh: 我在桶里转身，把水挤出去。
lines.en: I turn in the bucket and squeeze the water out.

lines.zh: 你这么小一只桶，真敢装我。
lines.en: Such a small bucket, and you dare put me in it.

lines.zh: 我成了你桶里最沉的那只眼。
lines.en: I am the heaviest eye in your bucket.

lines.zh: 前方有影子在动，我看清了。
lines.en: A shadow moves ahead and I have it clearly.

lines.zh: 那东西不像鱼，但也不像石头。
lines.en: That thing is not a fish, nor is it stone.

lines.zh: 我转向那边，水被我推开。
lines.en: I turn that way and the water parts for me.

lines.zh: 我锁定了它，眼睛不再动。
lines.en: I fix on it and my eyes stop moving.

lines.zh: 一点血腥味，让我朝那边游。
lines.en: A trace of blood sends me swimming that way.

lines.zh: 它动得太急，反而暴露了自己。
lines.en: It moves too hastily and gives itself away.

lines.zh: 我发现它时，它还没发现我。
lines.en: I found it while it had not yet found me.

lines.zh: 那道水纹告诉了我方向。
lines.en: That ripple told me the direction.

lines.zh: 目标在暗处，我的眼睛够用。
lines.en: The target is in the dark; my eyes are enough.

lines.zh: 我看准了，才开始动身。
lines.en: Only once I am sure do I start to move.

lines.zh: 我一点点靠近，眼睛一直没眨。
lines.en: I close in slowly, my eyes never blinking.

lines.zh: 我绕开它的正面，从侧面去。
lines.en: I avoid its front and come in from the side.

lines.zh: 它一动，我就停下等它放松。
lines.en: When it moves, I stop and wait for it to relax.

lines.zh: 我再近一尺，它就该察觉了。
lines.en: One more foot and it will notice me.

lines.zh: 我算好了距离，才摆尾。
lines.en: I calculate the distance before I beat my tail.

lines.zh: 水被我推得很轻，几乎无声。
lines.en: The water I push is slight, almost silent.

lines.zh: 它背对着我，这是个好位置。
lines.en: It has its back to me; this is a good position.

lines.zh: 我贴着水底慢慢挪，巨大的眼睛盯着你。
lines.en: I creep along the bottom, huge eyes fixed on you.

lines.zh: 它突然回头，我立刻定住。
lines.en: It turns suddenly and I freeze at once.

lines.zh: 就差一点，我张口了。
lines.en: Just a little closer, and I open my mouth.

lines.zh: 我用整条身子撞过去，水都炸开。
lines.en: I slam my whole body in and the water bursts.

lines.zh: 这一下很重，它退了半步。
lines.en: The blow is heavy; it gives half a step.

lines.zh: 我咬住它，牙陷进去一点。
lines.en: I bite down and my teeth sink in a little.

lines.zh: 我甩头，把它拖得站不稳。
lines.en: I wrench my head and drag it off balance.

lines.zh: 五点血不算多，可我很沉。
lines.en: Five health is not much, but I am heavy.

lines.zh: 我的大嘴合上，声音很闷。
lines.en: My big mouth closes with a muffled sound.

lines.zh: 撞完我退回暗处，继续看着。
lines.en: After the hit I withdraw into the dark and watch.

lines.zh: 一下就把它的气焰压下去了。
lines.en: One blow is enough to flatten its nerve.

lines.zh: 我不常动手，动手就一次。
lines.en: I rarely strike, and when I do it is once.

lines.zh: 打完，我盯着它爬走。
lines.en: When it is over, I watch it crawl away.

lines.zh: 我不是生成的，是钩子把我拖出来。
lines.en: I was not spawned; a hook dragged me out.

lines.zh: 虚空的水面裂开，我露了出来。
lines.en: The void's surface breaks and I come through.

lines.zh: 钓线一紧，我整条被扯上来。
lines.en: The line snaps taut and I am hauled up whole.

lines.zh: 第一眼看见的，是水面上的光。
lines.en: The first thing I see is light above the water.

lines.zh: 我从很深的地方被拉到这里。
lines.en: I am pulled here from somewhere very deep.

lines.zh: 我这样大的鱼，上钩时线都在叫。
lines.en: A fish my size makes the line scream.

lines.zh: 没有族群等我，只有一只桶。
lines.en: No school waits for me, only a bucket.

lines.zh: 我在水面翻了个身，眼睛睁着。
lines.en: I turn over at the surface, eyes open.

lines.zh: 出来的时候，水花比我还高。
lines.en: When I came out, the splash rose higher than me.

lines.zh: 我来了，从没人到过的虚空。
lines.en: I arrive, from a void no one has entered.

lines.zh: 火一过，我直接成了熟鱼。
lines.en: The flame passes and I am cooked through.

lines.zh: 我从水面摔下，砸出很大的水花。
lines.en: Falling from the surface, I raise a huge splash.

lines.zh: 我在水里，却还是被呛到了。
lines.en: I am in water, and still it chokes me.

lines.zh: 爆炸把我掀翻，眼睛还睁着。
lines.en: The blast flips me over, my eyes still open.

lines.zh: 一支箭钉在我鳍上，我甩不掉。
lines.en: An arrow sticks in my fin and will not shake loose.

lines.zh: 紫光落进我的眼睛，眼前全白。
lines.en: Violet light fills my eyes and everything goes white.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有猎物，我饿得发晕。
lines.en: No prey in the void; hunger makes my head swim.

lines.zh: 雷打进水里，我整条鱼僵住。
lines.en: Lightning strikes the water and my whole body locks.

lines.zh: 虚空从我身边漏走，我开始下坠。
lines.en: The void drains away beside me and I start to fall.
